name: Chimaeric Horn

meta.previous: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

summary: In the Charred Vale, a suffering chimaera matriarch tests a Horde warrior’s strength and mercy. Orm Stonehoof needs her horn for the Brutal Helm, and the hunt will prove the warrior’s resolve.

sections.title: A Test of Resolve
sections.body: Orm Stonehoof will forge the Brutal Helm for Horde warriors, but custom asks for proof before he begins. Metal and coin are not enough. A warrior must show martial skill and face the scars left by devastating conflict.

sections.title: The Scars of the Charred Vale
sections.body: The Charred Vale lies in the southwestern Stonetalon Mountains, buried in ash. Once lush and green, the valley was burned into a smoking wasteland. Beasts still roam its soot-covered craters, twisted by pain and fury. Mighty chimaeras nest among dead trees and searing steam vents.

sections.title: Mercy in Combat
sections.body: To the tauren smith, the chimaera matriarch’s horn is needed for the helm and proves a warrior’s strength. Yet the hunt also ends her torment. By felling the matriarch, the warrior brings mercy to a wild spirit driven mad by the destruction of her home.

faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof is a skilled tauren blacksmith in Thunder Bluff who helps veteran Horde warriors craft their class armor, including the Brutal Helm.

faq.q: Why does Orm want the galvanized horn?
faq.answer: Orm wants the galvanized horn because it is a durable part of the Brutal Helm. Taking it also proves the warrior had courage to track and defeat a dangerous alpha predator in hazardous terrain.
Chimaeras are large, two-headed winged beasts native to Kalimdor. Fire and destruction in the Charred Vale have driven its surviving chimaeras violently mad.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into warrior training?
faq.answer: Around their thirtieth season, Horde warriors go to specialists such as Orm Stonehoof for dangerous trials. Completing these trials earns them the right to wear the heavy, spiked Brutal armor set made for battlefield champions.

faq.q: Why does Orm frame the hunt as an act of mercy?
faq.answer: Tauren culture honors harmony with the earth and its creatures. The Charred Vale’s inhabitants suffer from the devastation of their land, so slaying the matriarch is seen as ending her unrelenting pain, not as mindless slaughter.

angles.text: As a warrior, you prove your skill by hunting a solitary alpha beast in a brutal place. This earns you the right to wear the Brutal Helm.
As a tauren, you hear Orm Stonehoof’s reverence in his words. Even in battle, ending a tormented beast’s suffering honors the Earth Mother.
As a member of the Horde, you travel from Sun Rock Retreat into Stonetalon’s contested wilds. There, you forge the arms needed for Kalimdor’s defense.
